reviews.title: Charged despite cancelling
reviews.text: Buyers beware. I downloaded this app and used during the free trial but it didn’t meet my needs so I cancelled in the app before the free trial was over. After cancelling, my profile in the HomeAI app had a “restore purchase” which led me to believe that the cancellation had processed. However, I recently found out that Apple has been charging me a $9.99 weekly subscription for this app, despite having canceled it within my app profile. I paid close to $250 in fees before realizing this mistake. I reached out to Home AI customer service and they essentially said it wasn’t their issue and to contact the Apple App store because they are a reseller. They specifically said that they don’t have the ability to modify or cancel subscriptions purchased through the App Store. I contacted Apple for a refund but it was denied. Sharing so others are not blindsided by this disconnect between subscriptions managed in by the HomeAI app vs the App Store.

This app might as well be called home design by clowns because it’s a joke.

I’ve now wasted 30 minutes and all I needed was to see what my flip house would look like with 1 larger window with shutters and some plants against the front. Don’t waste your time or money. Try a different app.!

reviews.title: Violation of FTC “Click to Cancel” rules.
reviews.text: I thought it was illegal now to develop a subscription service without presenting any way to cancel before being charged?!  I downloaded this app just to see what it was and it automatically enrolled me in a 3 day trial with a $9.99 weekly subscription fee with no way of canceling it!   What the heck! I never used this app and if I am charged tomorrow I will be contacting all the powers that be to get my money back or start making phone calls and inquiries into filing a class action lawsuit which I think would work because I just now noticed many other user reviews buried in here that had the same problem.  Federal FTC “Click to Cancel” is being violated here. Oh and I live in Texas where they have a secondary law banning this.

reviews.title: Do not download!!
